title: Duplexer Module - n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR) for Satellite L-Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Anya Krishnamurthy

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Duplexer Module filter targeting n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR) for Satellite L-Band Filter. The filter is designed on ScAlN on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 5254.5 MHz and bandwidth of 307.8 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Satellite L-Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Duplexer Module
- Frequency Band: n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR)
- Application: Satellite L-Band Filter
- Substrate: ScAlN on Si
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: Ansys HFSS 2024R1
- Design Center: San Jose Advanced Design Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Duplexer Module design targeting n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       5254.5 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       307.8 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.2 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 18.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 52.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 42.0 dB
Q Factor:               6040
Temperature Coefficient:-17.7 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.0 x 1.2 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   10
Electrode Material:     W
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Ansys HFSS 2024R1 and load the Duplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: ScAlN on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 5254.5 MHz, BW 307.8 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.2 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, ScAlN on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N5227B PNA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 15764 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.2 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 18.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 462 MHz offset >= 52.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 4 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 11.6 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +28 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 1000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 86%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-01-20
Devices Tested:         24
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.95 dB
Return Loss (meas):     19.7 dB
Rejection (meas):       54.7 dB
Isolation (meas):       46.6 dB
Q Factor (meas):        6040
Group Delay Variation:  7.9 ns
Power Handling:         +31 dBm
Die Yield:              96.1%

Result Classification:  PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Duplexer Module design demonstrated excellent performance for n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz 5G NR).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Design passed all acceptance criteria.
